meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 241 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail

blurb: A field of low volcanic domes in Oceanus Procellarum, and the most discussed lava-tube skylight on the Moon — a 65 m hole into a tube that would make a ready-made habitat.
